intelligence.title: Local model management
intelligence.dialogSubtitle: Download and manage the on-device inference models and dependencies used for image semantic search and face recognition.
intelligence.featureHint: Master switch. When enabled you can download and manage CLIP / face recognition models locally.
intelligence.featureBannerOff: Local models are disabled. Turn on the master switch above before downloading or using any model.
intelligence.mirrorHint: If huggingface.co is unreachable, set a mirror like https://hf-mirror.com. Leave empty to use the official source.
intelligence.clipFriendlyDesc: Search photos with a natural-language phrase such as “sunset by the sea”. The model runs locally and never uploads your data.
intelligence.faceFriendlyDesc: Detect faces in your images and group the same person together, so you can browse the library by character. Everything runs on-device.
intelligence.enableCapabilityHint: When on, this model is used by search / face clustering pipelines.
intelligence.enableCapabilityNeedDownload: Download the model first; this switch will become available once it’s ready.
intelligence.removeConfirm: Remove the downloaded model files? The capability will stop working until you download again.
intelligence.downloadStarted: Download started. You can monitor progress here.
intelligence.missingDepsTitle: Missing {count} pip dependencies — engine may fail to start
intelligence.installDepsStarted: Installing missing dependencies — model files won’t be re-downloaded.
intelligence.clipIndexHint: {count} images indexed. New images are indexed automatically; click the button to rerun a scan.
intelligence.faceQualityHint: Newly imported images are scanned automatically; raise these thresholds to skip blurry or tiny faces during indexing.
intelligence.faceMinFaceSizeHint: Reject face boxes whose shorter side is below this many pixels. Recommended: 40–120.
intelligence.faceMinBlurVarHint: Laplacian variance on 112×112 aligned face; higher = sharper. 0 disables. Recommended: 40–120.
intelligence.facePruneHint: Apply the current thresholds retroactively to drop low-quality faces already in the database (variance only checked on entries that already have a value).
intelligence.facePruneConfirm: Delete existing faces below score ≥ {score}, side ≥ {size}px, sharpness ≥ {blur}? This cannot be undone.
